cds.title: DePauw University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (all sections, PDF)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class, CDS C1: 6,772 applied (3,343 men + 3,423 women + 6 unknown), 3,794 admitted (1,748 + 2,042 + 4), 484 enrolled (236 + 247 + 1, all full-time). DePauw left the C1 residency table (in-state / out-of-state / international), the C2 waitlist counts and the early decision / early action counts blank, so none are shown, although the CDS says it offers both early decision and early action plans and has a waitlist policy. International first-years enrolled: 78 (B2 nonresident, first-time). SAT/ACT are optional: 53% (256 students) of the entering class submitted the SAT and 19% (90) the ACT. GPA: the CDS prints a 3.90 average for 100% of the class, with the 'all enrolled students' distribution shown (it does not say whether the GPA is weighted). Undergraduate enrollment (1,858) and the international count (391) are the B1/B2 'total undergraduates' figures (international = nonresidents).

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance. The 2025-26 Common Data Set (G1) ticks '2026-2027 costs of attendance are not available' (final costs 'Spring 2026') and leaves the tuition, fees and food-and-housing lines blank, so no CDS cost block could be used.
